changelog: Web Control Console v1, scoped npm and Homebrew distribution, verified public provenance, and the exact 20-tool MCP contract.
summary: Operate TraeCN through TRAECNclaw's focused stdio MCP tools. Use when an MCP-capable agent must send or stop work, choose a workspace/model/mode/conversation, inspect or change Trae settings through its UI, manage conversations, or resolve an exceptional question or command approval. Queueing, waiting, recovery, notifications, routine non-command questions, and keep/revert gates are gateway-managed.
